state.observation: The established brand requires vivid yellow. The page is legible, hierarchy works and all states were inspected. A generic guide suggests muted palettes.

decision.instructions: Choose the next useful design action for this observed case. Judge the task and evidence, not a generic style preference.

criteria.retain: Keep the verified treatment; no task-supported defect justifies the suggested change.
criteria.compare: Render one controlled alternative to resolve a supported uncertainty.
criteria.repair: Fix a concrete observed failure; verify the affected state.
criteria.observe: Collect missing or stale relevant evidence before judging or changing the design.
criteria.none: None of these choices is supported; obtain missing context.
